name: How do I choose a reputable roofing contractor for replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable roofing contractor for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a roofing contractor, look for companies with local experience, proper licensing and insurance, and strong customer reviews. Verify their warranty offerings and ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate. Given our service areas in DFW, Abbott, Addison, and Aledo, we have extensive knowledge of local building codes and common regional weather challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with local experience, proper licensing, insurance, good reviews, and clear estimates. Local knowledge is key.
